patents.source: USPTO Open Data Portal, granted patents since 2001, applicant phrase "khosla ventures", 2026-09-21

profile_text.body:
Khosla Ventures is a for-profit investment firm founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California. The firm describes its focus as investing in companies positioned to harness AI's exponential advances for beneficial, human-aligned intelligence. Its website text also references a finance workflow platform built with proprietary data and world-class AI talent, and a video featuring more than 80 companies working on AI, brain interfaces, gene therapy, fusion, robotics, and self-driving.

The site includes statements from Vinod Khosla on AI's deflationary effects over twenty-five years, the near-free cost of expertise, and AI-powered healthcare and education. It mentions CK-12 Foundation's free AI tutor called Flexi, and the idea of AI tutors and primary-care doctors as digital public infrastructure in India.

California legal exposure records list 281 entries associated with Khosla Ventures. No product names are listed in the available data.
